intro: COSHH is the law requiring employers to control hazardous substances, protecting you, colleagues and the people you support from everyday harm.
points: A COSHH assessment must be done before a hazardous substance is used; read the label and safety data sheet first.
Never mix cleaning chemicals — bleach with acids or ammonia releases toxic gas that can seriously harm your lungs.
Follow the hierarchy of control; PPE is the last line of defence, never the first thing you rely on.
Keep substances in their original labelled containers; never decant into an unlabelled bottle or a drinks container.
Store hazardous substances safely — cool, ventilated, away from food and out of reach of the people you support.
Report exposures, spills and ill health promptly; some conditions must be reported to the HSE under RIDDOR.
